base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl protobuf-compiler pkg-config libssl-dev

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: cargo test runs dependency resolution automatically
runtime_profile.notes: Rust 1.79 toolchain with cargo. Project requires minimum Rust 1.75. Protobuf compiler required for proto message generation.

notes: DataFusion Comet is a Rust workspace with members: core, spark-expr, proto. The fix.patch modifies Rust files for Decimal128 arithmetic optimization. Base image recommendation: rust:1.79-slim-bookworm or equivalent. git and curl are baseline system packages. protobuf-compiler is required for building the proto crate. The test command is 'cd native && cargo test'.
